events.description: AI in Fleet Management A Wunder Mobility Meetup — Hamburg Every operator is being told that AI will transform fleet operations. Far fewer people can tell you which parts already work and which are still a demo with good lighting. That is what this evening is for. We will show what we have actually shipped — where AI is already taking real work out of dispatch, maintenance, pricing and customer support — and we will be just as clear about where it is not ready yet. Then we hand the room over to the operators and builders running their own experiments, so you leave knowing what to adopt now, what to pilot, and what you cannot afford to miss right now while everyone else is still debating it. No product pitch dressed up as a talk. A room of people who run fleets, comparing notes on the tools that are actually moving the numbers. This is an invite-only event for senior leaders and builders in shared mobility. If you are in the room, it is because you belong in the conversation. Agenda Optional afternoon classes — 15:00 to 18:00 Ahead of the meetup we run three parallel tracks of hands-on classes on AI in fleet management, from beginner to advanced.
